name: marvin-enhancement-suite
description: Unofficial fixes and opt-in power tools for Amazing Marvin.
author: Raj Piskala

scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:firefox
scripts.build-for-amo: npm run clean && npm run icons && npm run typecheck && npm run build:all && npm run lint:firefox && npm run zip:chrome && npm run zip:firefox && npm run verify:release
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test:source && npm run build:all && npm run lint:firefox && npm run test:build
scripts.release: npm run clean && npm run icons && npm run check && npm run zip:chrome && npm run zip:firefox && npm run verify:release
scripts.test:source: npm run test:node && npm run test:vitest
scripts.test:node: node --test tests/autocomplete-cleanup.test.cjs tests/explicit-duration.test.cjs tests/procrastination-date.test.cjs tests/subtask-toggle.test.cjs tests/task-unroller.test.cjs tests/ui-contract.test.cjs
scripts.test:vitest: vitest run tests/settings.test.ts tests/unroller-api.test.ts tests/security.test.ts tests/task-unroller-permissions.test.ts
